data: Highly recommend Diablo 4, great game, good story, great atmosphere and gameplay
i definitely recommend it for the replayability, for the pretty good story and the quality of the ambience and great voice acting
it very good the story is amazing and graphics are fantastic the gameplay is very smooth
Gameplay is good, graphics are pretty good, story is good, and the soundtrack is awesome
I definitely recommend playing this game, especially if it's on sale
I do  not recommend you waste your time and money on this game
This story is so lackluster, uninteresting, boring, nothing garbage
I can't recommend this game, it feels like a huge waste of time with all the content that gets removed
Boring campaing and terrible gameplay, not worth your money
Lag so bad it is unplayable
definitely not worth ur time and money, skip this garbage
The corporate greed has no limits
-Absolute SCAM for the players who bought the previous DLC
, the monetisation is just awful, 25€ for a character skin
You spend so much time in this game going somewhere, listening to minutes of unskippable, absolute boring and cliche dialogue, and go somewhere else again
The story is completely flat and garbage, and the music is so unnoticeable it might as well be absent
ultimately a grindy, corporate owned, pay-to-win mess
Which is ridiculous as 2 more hours of gameplay is not far past the 2 hour limit
No character development, no story, and a real slog to get to endgame
the game mechanics just don't work
the company behind is so greedy that you need DLC for almost half of the gameplay
As a result, the game offered almost no real challenge, which made combat pretty boring
- constant fucking stuttering that makes game literally UNPLAYABLE
I pleaded my case on two separate occasions to Steam for a refund for  a broken game and they simply refused and simply don't care
The game itself is broken and there is no quality control coming from Steam themselves
While Diablo IV is quite entertaining with friends, it's intense monetization mechanics breaks the joy out of the game it could be.

Despite being the most popular? ARPG title, this game has the most basic mechanics and lacks a lot of QOL like map overlay and such that's already existed even before the computers were invented. If you are new to arpg and just wanna start killing stuff, I recommend this game as a stepping stone to learning the genre but if you want something more complex PoE and Last Epoch are a much better choice.

Don't WASTE your money!! Constant connection issues. Lost over 30 min. of play time just today. I have lost numerous dungeon keys, it's all due to steam and connection issues. Would love to play a game that I paid for without all the connection issues. Tighten Up STEAM
Playing POE2 felt like seeing colors for the first time, i will never again go back and play this game

Just to clarify I bought this on release on battle.net and completed the first season and the story etc but recently got it on steam to play through this season and the dlc to see what has changed.

If i could give this game a mixed review I would because it has some issues that I really think should have been solved by now, dont get me wrong I love the game and the world it has built but it has its issues such as bugs that have been in the game for well over a year, leading to quests not being able to be completed or dungeons unable to be finished. I do love the combat of the game and the variety of builds you can have, I also love that you can fine tune your armour and weapons to fit your build and the loot is fun and feels rewarding to me. This game is definitely a lot easier than other games within the genre so I do recommend this when its on sale only and they do plenty of free weekends for people to try, I will however give it a positive overall because I am leaning more towards positive than negative.

Tried it on a free week 8/22/24. Server connection required for single player only to disconnect 3 times. Oh don't worry the in game shop still works though. Console version of D3 didn't need server connection & I thought it was showing the end of this moronic need to be connected to play what you purchase alone. Nice reverting to an old anti consumer practice, as long as this trash is required you're not getting my money.
Entertaining enough. I like to complete some run while listening to podcasts, but I don't expect to be good enough of a player to reach T4.
The game used to run great until Lord of Hatred dropped and now i can't stay in a game for more than 2 minutes before it drops connection. unplayable

Season 2 has enough QOL fixes and new overworld end game stuff to do that I feel like it’s a lot easier to recommend this now. Upcoming changes have also been positive. Unfortunate that every AAA game comes in hot nowadays.

It's a great game to dip into for a bit of exploring and hack and slash. Each character type offers a different game play experience.
What I'm not enjoying so much (about 8 hours in at the moment) are the server connection issues.
Seems like bad design when I need to be connected continuously to their servers, when I'm playing single player only. Why can't I be offline if needs be, with the game synching to their cloud when it can.
I've had a couple of connection errors, not being able to get back into the game, and resetting part of my progress, all this with a rock solid 1000/100 connection and a 13ms ping.
Characters seem a bit unbalanced.
The necro with the skeletons is very powerful, also the mage with fire dragons.

I've been lied to on this supposed 'free weekend'. A waste of a morning and a 120GB download.

There should have been information that this was a limited trial, not a proper free weekend. The developers should have updated the Steam page to reflect it.

Instead now I've wasted my time and have been bait and switched.

Why would I ever support devs like this? :clown_ooo::clown_ooo::clown_ooo:

Also one can see the disgusting behavior of the insertion of paid DLC/Cosmetics at every turn in the game.

Its a good mix between D2 and D3 in my book. I wish it had a more controller friendly inventory menu layout like D3 for console had. Also I am not a huge fan of these branching skill tree layouts a lot of these games have as they seem overly convoluted. Still I enjoy playing it and thats what matters.

Game is ridiculously easy. No challenge. The max difficulty on campaign is still virtually impossible to die. Why level to "end game" if the early game puts you to sleep? Past Diablo games made you consider enemy tactics and required you to pay attention to their attacks. Now you can play a spellcaster in melee range and face-tank bosses without dying or worrying about any mechanic. Part of what makes games fun is limitation and overcoming obstacles. If there's no threat of losing, there's no fun.
Lots of fun. Of course, there's grinding involved, and some of it is repetitive, but hubby and I play it together so we have fun!

Most people are just review bombing the game because they're mad at blizzard.

But really, what do you expect from Diablo but grinding loot and exp. ? The story was quite nice, the open world is really good (still better than just replaying the same quests all over again as I did in Diablo 3).

The game is really good if you wanna braindead in front of something and kill minions. Unfortunately, Blizzard still Blizzard (and I want to remind you that the employees are definitely against all these micro transcations but the CEO is what he is.) so lots of things to buy in game but no pay to win/pay to fast.

Besides, I ll never understand people saying a game is trash after having played more than 100 hours...

I enjoyed the game very much, been playing Diablo for many years now and it does not disapoint if you know what you are getting yourself into. I can understand how some people would be disappointed by the game if they were expcting something different from D3. The core of the game has not changed but little things have.
This game is costly but worth every penny. So addicting and very story driven campaign. Loved it. 10/10

Despite the bad reviews, I love this game and totally think it was worth what we paid. It was on Cyber Monday sale, so we got a steal the hubby and I got the game on both our systems so we could game together, it was almost half off! :) Addicted for sure.

Diablo 4 is a very accessible and fun-to-play game that doesn't require the equivalent of a full-time job's effort to receive a lot of enjoyment from.
If you are a casual, or someone who just wants to have fun for an hour or two, simply ignore the ARPG Uber-Nerd commentary. Most of these people are hardcore gamers who likely have little else to do and can be very nit-picky and demanding.
At this point in time, the game is in a very good place from both a gameplay and technical standpoint. There are minor bugs here and there, but nothing showstopping.
If you think you will enjoy it, you probably will.
Buy on sale or at full price.

Zbytočne komplikovaný endgame, čo sa týka upravovania itemov atd.. nepotrebujem 30min rerollovať item, aby som dostal ten affix/stat, ktorý potrebujem. Grafika oka, ale toľko efektov, že človek ani nevidí, kde je a čo ho zabíja. Príbeh oka, ale na D2 nemá nič.

great game as are all the diablo's However this one is a cosmetic money grab. the battle pass is now poor more money less rewards and the seasons seem to lack originality and direction. there is no endgame content except for getting better items with extremely low drop rates to then go up in torment levels and get better items with lower drop rates, In my opinion it seems like the main objective of the creators is to keep you in a sensless grind so they can log players online statistics to make the game look more popular or enjoyable than it is.
Still as a long time fan of the series i will continue to play, however it will be blasting through seasonal content for a couple of days then putting it down until the next season is released.
Gameplay loop is okay. Story is very boring, with forgettable characters and tedious dungeons. Don't waste your money.

I've tried several games of the same genre, tried PoE for 130+ hours, Grimdawn 50+, Last epoch 100+, Lost ark 100+ and V rising, and nothing came even close to how good the gameplay feels like in d4... I've yet to see a game do what d4 does when it comes to gameplay fluidity and honestly it just feels crisp af.

Nevertheless I dont think I'm that delusional, No doubt the game has its flaws, you can pretty much look up d4 and you'll get slammed in the face with a mother load of content that has a general negative look at the game and at blizzard... but... i still had so much more fun playing d4 than any of the other games i mentioned. After Lost ark and PoE i pretty much gave up on games like these having a good coherent, cinematic story(Except the ending), but I was genuinely surprised with d4's story, i even found myself listening in and enjoying side quests unlike mashing the G button in Lost ark.....
Anyway, I can see that the devs are really trying their damn hardest here, and I really hope Season 4 fixes alot of the things that are blatantly just killing the game...
Fun until you get to the endgame unfortunately, basically watch the south park episode about WoW and you'll get it, by the time you're ready to play the game there's no more content.

Never played any other game like Diablo before and tbh am really taken to it. i understand that there is the hardcore gamers that have there hate maybe for there own reasons but am loving this game and each season giving a new theme its cool. game runs fine on my end so maybe others run game on far too high of graphics and then they have the issues but again am not a pc or game expert so i happy to enjoy new types of games.

I love Diablo and was looking forward to playing this. However greed has ruined the experience for me. I bought an expensive bundle that cost 63. A notification to check your battle pass CONSTANTLY appears, even if you check, even if you click off. It's obnoxious. I bought all the free battle pass rewards and the notification is still there. It's super disruptive. Either you have to keep playing and max out those coins, which means playing while disrupted OR you have to buy the battle pass and spend those coins. Either way, the game pisses you off. Pure greed. The game is expensive as it is and there's a shop. There's 0 excuse for forcing this on the player. I'm refunding it and will never purchase another Blizzard product until this is sorted.

I get that a lot of people have complaints on this game with the pricey cosmetics, but i got it any ways and i'm having a blast. The game is addicting and has really good visuals and story telling. The music is awesome as well. I still think it deserves play time and you can easily get 60 + hours of fun out of it. I got it on sale for half the price. $70 might be too much especially that you have to pay for cosmetics and pay for a battle pass. Anyways, i'd still give this a B+ since i don't like the idea of cosmetics being paid for and not attainable completing challenges or being cheaper in general since you already sunk in $70 into it.

Looks great and fun to play. A bit on the expensive side, but I bought it anyways and don't regret it. Maybe that I didn't get it sooner. Being new to this game, It was some what intuitive to get started, but still a learning curve
It's a Micro-transaction Store attached to an already premium priced game. There is no real end-game. Do Not Buy

the story, if there even is one, is completely overshadowed by the fact that you have to scavenger hunt all your equipment and rely on everchanging build guides like a dickhead. you can’t even build something organically and have fun with it. wtf happened to the potions?? -10/10. try hard devs want people to be addicted; that's the only goal and it shows.

it costs one hundred MILLION (100,000,000) gold to forge 2 mythics at the blacksmith, and the resale value of the stupid useless mythics that i cant even use or need for my build? 130k gold.

boring- just all grinding before season ends, eternal sucks you lose everything... not a great game there isnt much fun stuff, lair bosses arent even fun since you just die, die, and wait 10 hours to defeat them. the leveling also sucks, theres lots more that sucks even. I would NOT reccomend this - Edit :the dlc and and game is also overpriced, aswell as most of the endgame features being just grindy, it also has a horrible intro to grindfy games, and there is no full guide for what todo.

I recommend this game if its on sale. I understand what some of the reviews meant now by online game. It means that if you complete a quest there are times where the server hiccups and forgets that you did the quest (even when you're playing single player). Or at other times, you go to complete a quest, but the server is busy enough that someone else just finished that quest and you can't do the quest until it does a reset of those NPCs. Basically, this is Diablo Online and you pay a one-time fee (no subscription costs, yet). They have a pricing model where they try and get more money from you with cosmetics, etc. If you know that going in, maybe its not so bad. Still, it is not Diablo IV ... at least not in the sense that it is a stand-alone game. If you want to play it with friends you might really prefer this, but alas I am a loner.

I really really enjoy this game!

Had not played any Diablo game before and
of course was slighly concerned due to the overall / previous rating of the game.
I actually bought this game on Christmas sale due to the great compatibility with the Steam Deck
and 16 hours into the game i'm very happy about this decision.

I love being able to play a Druid (like in my WOW times) becoming a huge bear,
walking through this gloomy, icy dark world, smahing hordes of monsters.
I really like the campaign so far and im looking forward each day to grab my Steam Deck
after work and continue for 1-2 hours.

I do not know yet know what awaits me, how the endgame is, how seasons work but i guess
it will be great doing some dungeons in coop-mode, trying out other classes and
the best thing is - an expansion is going to be released end of this year...

The game is like a caramel onion. Despite a sale on the price and all the fantastic work done by the with season 2, the game is still not worth it.
It needs expansion levels of attention which it likely won't receive, yet you'll be billed the same as any new AAA title.
The company has built a lot of bad faith, and despite recent changes across all their IPs the value is still not there and the consumer is squeezed for you have (as is normal in the industry these days...).
Not worth, will check back if anything notable changes in the coming years.

Not only is this game nowhere near as good as the previous games. This is one of those "online only BS" games that says it needs to be connected to the mother ship at all times but it's a complete and utter lie. The only reason this game is "online only" is money, pure unadulterated greed of the highest order. Please do not buy this game, I am very sorry I did.

After a 1000 hours, I have learned that this game relies entirely on RNG mechanics, and you can spend 100's of hours on a build, which ends not really working at a certain point. Which means you then have rebuild from scratch or try to follow a meta build. And the game is good, but if you like theory crafting, and template building, don't bother, it's all gated behind fruit machine mechanics that eventually just gets annoying.
Good to waste some time with, ive played since the original diablo so well worth playing especially when hours of gameplay is stained in your history.
Full of bugs.. especially the data one. Already did everything from forums, yet game that you pay almost 60 eu for, just crashes...
It doesn’t even touch the high standards one would expect from the old Blizzard; it’s just okay.

I bought this game three times, Once on Bnet, once on xbox, and once on steam. I get that I needed to do so to unlock the content on each platform.

But I'm not buying the expansion on every platform when battlenet already knows that my account owns the expansion anyway.

Fix this Blizzard. I own the expansion already. If I want to stream the game via my steamdeck or on my xbox, please let me have access to all the content I paid for.

It's a good game to play with your friend in overall. But the company behind is so greedy that you need DLC for almost half of the gameplay. You can't go to some dungeons, you can't open some passive skills, you can't even move to half of the map without a dlc. Which is almost same price as the base game. This is pure greed.

Does the game have a lot of issues? Absolutely
Is the game still fun for a casual/hardcore player? Yes, more focused on the casual side

Blizzard will never be the company they were when they released Diablo 2/3. But my personal hope is that they keep supporting and improving Diablo 4. The game deserves to shine and stand out among ARPG's.

Who would’ve thought that Diablo 4 could rise from the ashes like a phoenix wielding a legendary sword? With better loot and bosses that don't feel like glorified punching bags, it’s like the devs finally remembered what game they were making. Now, instead of sobbing over another pair of "Legendary" Boots of Mild Discomfort, I’m scoring epic gear that makes me feel like a genuine badass. Boss fights have become epic showdowns rather than tedious chores, making me shout “Take that, you oversized piñata!” If this is the new normal, I might just forgive them for Diablo 3’s launch. Cheers to Diablo 4 for finally putting the 'hell' back in 'hell yeah!'

FUCKING SHIT CRAP GAME! The 2nd time without any warning I suddenly got disconnected close before concluding an game save triggering event! Every progress lost, and I'd to start from the last save point again! FOR FUCKS SAKE! Haven't played this game for 2.5 years because that shit already happend back then, and in late 2026 with an true stable 10Gbit fiber connection that crap still happens! FUCK YOU BLIZZARD, for wasting again a couple of hours of my live, which I'd have spent gaming with an more stable & satisfying game! >:((

Picked it up so I could play on the Steam Deck without needing to do all the work-arounds, but it would have been better if Blizzard had priced the game much cheaper if we had bought a copy on Battle.net already.

It's a bit complicated, but that makes if fun. Lots of things to figure out and an OK story line. 
There is also a wide variety of characters and builds to keep this all interesting.

I bought and played a little into Diablo 2R and Diablo 3. Both fun games, but this game than really catched me. I am quite into the Addiction. For who enjoys Quality of Life and good Graphics it is a great game. Especially Season 4 did a lot of good to the game.

I really enjoyed the story and was surprisingly more invested than I expected. 

Would recommend!

I honestly have a really good time with this game. Some people are hate it but the classes are fun the combat is satisfying. Its not perfect. There are some classes and specials that are better but its not broken. Season 3 was a little boring but its still fun to play.

A game without soul.
Levelling is ok, sometimes even enjoyable. However, you need to pick the appropriate aspects to have that enjoyable experience. 
The endgame is the most tedious boring loop ever created in a game. 
You can do Nightmare Dungeons (Pit is more of the same with different rewards), Whispers, World bosses or legions, or Uber bosses.
You found a 925 item with 2/3 bonuses you wanted, great. You can now gamble on changing the 3rd stat. What, you are out of money? No worries, just do some whispers! Every reroll is now 5mil? Do more whispers then. At last you got that 3rd stat, you can now masterwork the item by going into the pit. It takes around 8 runs to go 4/12 masterwork levels. Now do Pit 31lvl to upgrade it further. Oh, you got one-shotted? No worries, you now need to upgrade all the rest of your items to 4/12 to have a chance not to get one-shotted and finish lvl31+ Pit 10 times to upgrade one item all the way to 8/12. Brain dead activities for brain dead players.
Just make the item level drop scale with the activity I do.

I have a love/hate relationship with Blizzard for various, justifiable reasons -

But to be perfectly blunt: There are so many things to love about this game at it's core, which is why I think so many people, myself included even care at all that there's so much here that's just been done objectively wrong when it all could've (or at least should've) easily been avoided entirely.

The only reason I now own this on Steam, let alone will even continue to play this in the first place; Is entirely because of it being the game that my Husband & I happen to enjoy playing together.

Don't misunderstand me; I love the Diablo series a great deal; It actually saddens me seeing the franchise go from what it once was during Diablo 2 back in 2000 (even D3 was infinitely better than this) to what it is now, I suppose is my point - When realistically Blizzard COULD VERY EASILY FIX ALL OF THIS... They simply choose (or have chosen) not to.
